blocks.text: UAAP SCHEDULE: Season 89 basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—Things were quite different in National U’s match with the University of the Philippines in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament. At least for this game at Mall of Asia Arena. That’s because whenever the Fighting Maroons take any court, people clad in maroon would fill arenas and would chant their signature “U-nibersidad ng Pilipinas!” cheer. That day, however, the blue and gold crowd dominated the gallery. And Bulldogs coach Jeff Napa certainly noticed them. “When it comes to our crowd, I can’t talk enough about them,” Napa said in […]...
